intro: A teacher resume that shows impact on students and the school: results, programmes started, and responsibilities beyond the classroom.
tips: Name your subjects, year levels and certification up front.
Show student outcomes and programmes you created, with numbers.
Include responsibilities beyond teaching: coordination, mentoring, clubs.

basics.name: Michael Brennan
basics.label: Secondary Science Teacher
basics.summary: Registered secondary teacher (QCT) with eight years teaching science and physics to Years 7–12. Head of the junior science program, and founder of a robotics club that reached the national finals.

work.name: Riverside State High School
work.position: Science Teacher and Junior Science Coordinator
highlights: Teach physics and general science to five classes a week across Years 9–12.
Rewrote the Year 9 science program around hands-on inquiry; the share of students choosing senior science rose from 38% to 51%.
Founded the robotics club; 40 students a year, two national finals.

work.name: St. Columba's College
highlights: Taught Years 7–10 science and coached the debating team.
Mentored two graduate teachers through registration.
